packet.description_seed: Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

what: Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting, authorities say

clean_source_blocks.text: There has been a lull in the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah since Sunday Israeli soldiers have shot dead two people in southern Lebanon, the Lebanese health ministry says, in the first fatal incident reported since the latest ceasefire between Israel and the Iran-backed armed group Hezbollah appeared to take hold at the weekend. Lebanon's state-run National News Agency said two men were killed while they were standing near a bulldozer that was unblocking a road in the town of Nabatieh al-Fawqa. Hezbollah condemned the shooting as "a blatant violation of the ceasefire". Israel's military said soldiers in the Ali al-Taher ridge area, just east of Nabatieh al-Fawqa, fired at "four Hezbollah terrorists riding a bulldozer and a motorcycle" who posed a threat.
Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

After the group of people continued to approach, “additional fire was conducted in order to remove the threat”.In a separate incident, the Israeli military said it “struck armed terrorists who posed an immediate threat” to soldiers in the Ali al-Taher ridge area – located within the same area of the south. Hezbollah, in a statement, said two civilians were killed in the Nabatieh al-Fawqa shooting and accused Israel of violating the ceasefire. It did not say whether it intended to respond. Asked about the latest incident, Iran’s ambassador to the United Nations in Geneva, Ali Bahreini, told reporters that any violation of the memorandum of understanding in Lebanon would create challenges for peace talks. “Lebanon is an unquestionable part of the agreement, and whatever happens in Lebanon affects the whole process, and it is the United States which ---

Hezbollah's military wing, the Islamic Resistance, said in a statement: "What the enemy has committed constitutes a blatant violation of the ceasefire, which the Resistance has adhered to up to this point". It did not say whether the group would retaliate. Displaced families are continuing to return to their homes in southern Lebanon Ali al-Taher ridge, which overlooks much of south-eastern Lebanon including the major town of Nabatieh, has been one of the most fiercely contested positions in the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah. Israeli ground forces attempted to seize the ridge - where they believe there is a Hezbollah "underground military fortress" - in the days before the new ceasefire deal was announced. Four soldiers were killed in a Hezbollah attack on their tank in the nearby village of Kfar Tebnit early on Friday.

payload.title: Kaksi kuoli Etelä-Libanonissa tulituksessa aselevon jälkeen
payload.summary: Libanonin terveysministeriön mukaan Israelin sotilaat ampuivat kaksi ihmistä Etelä-Libanonissa. Israelin armeija sanoo tulittaneensa uhaksi arvioimiaan Hizbollahin jäseniä, kun taas Hizbollah syyttää Israelia aselevon rikkomisesta.
payload.content:
Libanonin terveysministeriön mukaan Israelin sotilaat ovat ampuneet kuoliaaksi kaksi ihmistä Etelä-Libanonissa sen jälkeen, kun Israelin ja Hizbollahin väliset taistelut olivat hiljentyneet viikonloppuna voimaan tulleelta vaikuttaneen aselevon myötä. Tapausta kuvataan ensimmäiseksi kuolemaan johtaneeksi välikohtaukseksi sen jälkeen, kun uusi tulitauko alkoi pitää.

## Ampuminen tapahtui Nabatiehin lähellä

Libanonin valtiollisen uutistoimiston mukaan kaksi miestä kuoli Nabatieh al-Fawqan kaupungissa, kun he seisoivat puskutraktorin lähellä. Puskutraktorin kerrotaan olleen avaamassa tietä. Alue sijaitsee Etelä-Libanonissa lähellä Ali al-Taherin harjannetta, joka on ollut yksi Israelin ja Hizbollahin välisen konfliktin kiistellyimmistä paikoista.

Israelin armeijan mukaan sen sotilaat avasivat tulen Ali al-Taherin harjanteen alueella neljää Hizbollahin taistelijaa kohti. Armeijan mukaan nämä liikkuivat puskutraktorilla ja moottoripyörällä ja muodostivat uhan sotilaille. Israelin armeija sanoi myös erillisestä välikohtauksesta, että se oli iskenyt aseistettuihin henkilöihin, jotka sen mukaan aiheuttivat välittömän uhan samalla eteläisen Libanonin alueella.

## Hizbollah syyttää aselevon rikkomisesta

Hizbollah tuomitsi ampumisen ja kuvasi sitä räikeäksi aselevon rikkomiseksi. Ryhmä sanoi, että kuolleet olivat siviilejä, eikä se kertonut, aikooko se vastata tapahtuneeseen. Hizbollahin sotilaallinen siipi totesi lausunnossaan, että se oli omasta puolestaan noudattanut tulitaukoa tähän asti.

Etelä-Libanonissa siirtymään joutuneet perheet ovat jatkaneet paluutaan koteihinsa. Samalla Ali al-Taherin harjanteen asema tekee tilanteesta herkän: harjanne hallitsee näkymiä laajalle Kaakkois-Libanoniin, myös Nabatiehin kaupunkiin. Israelin maajoukot yrittivät vallata harjannetta päivinä ennen uuden aseleposopimuksen ilmoittamista, sillä Israel uskoo alueella olevan Hizbollahin maanalainen sotilastukikohta.

Iranin Geneven YK-suurlähettiläs Ali Bahreini sanoi toimittajille, että mikä tahansa Libanonia koskevan yhteisymmärryksen rikkominen vaikeuttaisi rauhanneuvotteluja. Hänen mukaansa Libanon on olennainen osa sopimusta, ja Libanonin tapahtumat vaikuttavat koko prosessiin. Lähialueen Kfar Tebnitissä neljä israelilaissotilasta kuoli Hizbollahin iskussa panssarivaunuun varhain perjantaina ennen uuden aselevon ilmoittamista.
summary_bullets: Libanonin terveysministeriön mukaan kaksi ihmistä kuoli Israelin sotilaiden tulituksessa Etelä-Libanonissa.
Israel sanoo tulittaneensa Hizbollahin jäseniä, jotka sen mukaan muodostivat uhan sotilaille.
Hizbollah kutsuu tapahtunutta aselevon rikkomiseksi eikä ole kertonut, aikooko se vastata.

article.source_text:
There has been a lull in the fighting between Israel and Hezbollah since Sunday Israeli soldiers have shot dead two people in southern Lebanon, the Lebanese health ministry says, in the first fatal incident reported since the latest ceasefire between Israel and the Iran-backed armed group Hezbollah appeared to take hold at the weekend. Lebanon's state-run National News Agency said two men were killed while they were standing near a bulldozer that was unblocking a road in the town of Nabatieh al-Fawqa. Hezbollah condemned the shooting as "a blatant violation of the ceasefire". Israel's military said soldiers in the Ali al-Taher ridge area, just east of Nabatieh al-Fawqa, fired at "four Hezbollah terrorists riding a bulldozer and a motorcycle" who posed a threat.

Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

After the group of people continued to approach, “additional fire was conducted in order to remove the threat”.In a separate incident, the Israeli military said it “struck armed terrorists who posed an immediate threat” to soldiers in the Ali al-Taher ridge area – located within the same area of the south. Hezbollah, in a statement, said two civilians were killed in the Nabatieh al-Fawqa shooting and accused Israel of violating the ceasefire. It did not say whether it intended to respond. Asked about the latest incident, Iran’s ambassador to the United Nations in Geneva, Ali Bahreini, told reporters that any violation of the memorandum of understanding in Lebanon would create challenges for peace talks. “Lebanon is an unquestionable part of the agreement, and whatever happens in Lebanon affects the whole process, and it is the United States which ---

Hezbollah's military wing, the Islamic Resistance, said in a statement: "What the enemy has committed constitutes a blatant violation of the ceasefire, which the Resistance has adhered to up to this point". It did not say whether the group would retaliate. Displaced families are continuing to return to their homes in southern Lebanon Ali al-Taher ridge, which overlooks much of south-eastern Lebanon including the major town of Nabatieh, has been one of the most fiercely contested positions in the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah. Israeli ground forces attempted to seize the ridge - where they believe there is a Hezbollah "underground military fortress" - in the days before the new ceasefire deal was announced. Four soldiers were killed in a Hezbollah attack on their tank in the nearby village of Kfar Tebnit early on Friday.
